note: WITHIN-SEED PAIRS ADDED TO THE RANKING LOSS, --rank-within-weight 1, --rank-topk-decay 0, 15 epochs. Identical to 24u34d/24u342 in every other setting, so this is a one-variable-pair comparison against the only arm that has ever beaten shipped on frac acceptable. WHAT CHANGES: (1) --rank-pairs all, so the loss forms BOTH cross-seed and within-seed pairs where 24u342 formed cross-seed only -- deployment selects argmax ipTM over ALL poses regardless of seed, so ordering inside a seed is part of what decides the pick and has never entered this objective; (2) --rank-within-weight 1 scales within-seed pairs in the numerator AND the normaliser W, making L a SHARE knob that cannot act as a second --alpha-rank (test_rank_loss.py asserts L normalises away when every pair is within-seed, has no effect under --rank-pairs cross, leaves the pair count alone, and keeps coefficients summing to zero); (3) --rank-tau 0.0270, the median |ipTM gap| over ALL 1,146,184 training pairs of both families across 497 structures, replacing the cross-seed-only DEFAULT_TAU of 0.0305. At L=1 within-seed pairs carry 7.0% of the pairwise score-space gradient mass against 7.0% at L=1 (reproduce: run_logging/within_weight.py --tau 0.0270), while mass reaching INVERTED pairs falls only 75.0% to 71.6% between L=1 and L=8. WHY THE WEIGHT AND NOT A SECOND TAU: within-seed pairs were never short of gradient -- at tau 0.0270 a median within-seed pair on overfit30 (gap 0.0137) weights 0.376 correctly ordered against 0.624 inverted, real discrimination, and both directions push toward the better-DockQ pose so they ADD rather than cancel. What they lack is SHARE: 7.9% of pairs by count. A multiplier is monotone in the quantity being targeted and can be set from a measurement; a second tau changes the weighting's SHAPE and its effect on mass share is not monotone. WHY TAU IS NOT RETUNED PER ARM: tau is fixed to a property of the data rather than to the knob, so the two arms differ in one thing. It does NOT equal the w_ij-weighted median (0.1329 at L=1, 0.0794 at L=8, both above tau) and no rule requires it to; DEFAULT_TAU has always been an unweighted median while the loss ran weight_by_gap=True. PARAMETERS, 44,032 over 12 tensors, unchanged from 24u34d: ANCHORED at lambda 2.5e-4, linear_no_bias_d (256x39) + linear_no_bias_d_wo_onehot (256x1) = 10,240 plus 3 per-block copies = 30,720, so 40,960 over 8 tensors; NOT ANCHORED, frame_dir_proj LinearNoBias(3 -> 256) = 768 plus 3 per-block orientation copies = 2,304 over 4 tensors, excluded via --l2-sp-exclude 'frame_dir' because they are ZERO-INIT and anchoring them to their init would be plain decay toward zero, penalising the term being added. pae_ln and linear_no_bias_pae stay FROZEN. --blocks-per-ckpt 0 IS LOAD-BEARING: the per-block orientation copies read pose_direction's cache, which the outer forward clears after the stack, so a checkpointed block would pair one pose's directions with another's gradient. NOT A RESUME, so --l2-sp snapshots the anchor at init from the SHIPPED head; the log should say 'anchor SNAPSHOT at init' here, which is the opposite of what a resume requires. CONTROLS: 24u342 (this arm minus within-seed pairs, tau 0.0305, 50 epochs, final DockQ 0.2790 +- 0.0568, frac 0.5556, rho 0.2163, paired first-acceptable-rank negative in all 33 evaluated epochs 18-50 with mean -1.25) and the companion arm at the other L. L8 (hronsr) RAN FIRST AT 15 EPOCHS: DockQ 0.3024 against shipped 0.2909, paired +0.0115 +- 0.0088 over the same 18 interfaces (1.3 sigma, 8 better / 4 worse / 6 same), POSITIVE IN ALL EIGHT EPOCHS 8-15 with mean +0.0114 and a minimum of +0.0084, frac unmoved at 0.5556 throughout. Not significant at any single epoch and the epochs are serially correlated, so it is a consistent sign rather than a result. It is also the first arm in this project to put DockQ ABOVE shipped at all -- 24u342's only win was frac, from one interface, with DockQ below. L1 is the control that says whether that came from the within-seed WEIGHTING or merely from tau 0.0270 and the presence of within-seed pairs. CRITERION: selected DockQ and fraction above 0.23 over the 18 val10 interfaces against shipped DockQ 0.2909 / frac 0.5556 / oracle 0.5968, derived from this run's own shards. Spearman is reported but is NOT the criterion. TOP-k RANK DECAY K=0: 0 means off; above 0 each pair is weighted by max(v(r_i), v(r_j)) with v(r)=exp(-(r-1)/K) over the current ipTM order, concentrating the loss on the pairs that can change the argmax -- at K=2, 39.3% of weight on pairs touching rank 1 against 1.6% undecayed, and 92.8% inside the top 5. Ranks come from DETACHED scores, so the weight is constant in the backward and this is not the exact gradient of a fixed objective. TEN-EPOCH MINIMUM before any trend claim. FALSIFIER: L=8 landing on L=1 within error on DockQ and frac, which would say the within-seed family carries no usable signal at any weight this objective can give it.
